description: React component for managing MCP servers, including controls for start, stop, restart, bulk actions, and a confirmation dialog.

methods.name: getActionText
methods.description: Returns display text for a given MCPServerAction.

methods.name: getActionIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon component for a given MCPServerAction.

methods.name: getActionColor
methods.description: Returns CSS class for coloring action buttons based on action type.

methods.name: isActionLoading
methods.description: Checks if a particular action on specific servers is currently loading.

methods.name: renderActionButton
methods.description: Renders a button for bulk server actions with loading state and event handling.

methods.name: executeAction
methods.description: Performs the specified server action, handling both individual and bulk operations.

methods.name: handleSingleAction
methods.description: Initiates actions on individual servers, with confirmation for destructive actions.

methods.name: handleBulkAction
methods.description: Initiates bulk server actions with confirmation dialog.
